For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Mukesh Kumar Singh  For the Respondent/s : Mr. Syed Eqbal Ahmad Sc-20  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 19-06-2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

The present application is filed for quashing the F.I.R. bearing Jamhore P.S. Case No. 33 of 2016,
corresponding to G.R. Case No. 1266/16 registered for the offence under sections 420, 406, 409 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submit that he has no instruction regarding the stage of the case in the court below.
Accordingly, this application is disposed of with liberty to the petitioner to raise all the grounds at an appropriate stage, if available, under law.

(Sandeep Kumar, J) Ranjeet/-
